content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"Payments calls jumped to 212 against 100 forecast in the 11:45 interval (+112%), and service level fell to 4.7% with 81 abandons. Earlier intervals were close to plan. The extra calls are concentrated in payment_status_enquiry (181 vs 110.3 expected) and refund_status (119 vs 84.8). That matches P2 incident INC-20261112-1271: IMPS/NEFT transfers are stuck pending after the account was debited. The ticket was opened at 11:58, just after calls started rising, and customers often call before a ticket is raised. Neither the KYC SMS nor attendance (4 sick vs 2.4 usual, all logged before 09:01) explains a sudden spike at 11:45.","evidence":[{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"11:45 interval: 212 calls vs 100 forecast (+112%).
